reviews.text: Terrific Vets and staff.  I have been going there for 10 years.  They take very good care of my dogs. They are compassionate and follow up when pets are ill.

Wonderful office. Just love Dr Reimer.
Very caring vet.
Dr. Reimer and his staff continue to be a loving and expert part of the lives of our family’s furry loved ones.
Love this vet office- all doctors are great!
Dr. Reimer is the Best as is his staff.

I previously posted a review which I have deleted. Time has passed and things are getting better. The problems that I was having with my parrot were difficult. At the time I felt like I was not getting the help I needed. It was a 24/7 constant situation,  never being to leave my parrot alone. It was very frustrating and it left me feeling hopeless. I’m glad to say my baby is getting better and I couldn’t have done it without Dr. Shinkle and the staff. With all our animals it is hard when they are sick. Parrots seem to have such a strong will instead of letting you help them they decide what to do what’s best for them which isn’t the right thing. After almost 3 months of 24/7 care I believe we are heading on the way for my baby to be healed. I want to thank Dr. Shinkle and staff for all their help. It’s been a hard and long 3 months.

I've been bringing my exotics to Dr Reimer for years and recently visited Dr Shinkle with a bunny as well.  Let me preface this by saying I've visited a lot of vets over the years, and have worked for/with about a dozen.  Dr's Reimer and Shinkle absolutely know what they are doing.  They will take time to explain things, they are extremely reasonably priced, and when I'm in a time pinch and can't wait long for help, they fit me in.  I will continue making the 45 minute drive to All Pets for as long as I have exotics.

DVM Reimer is the best. He’s is the only vet who went the distance to heal my desert tortoise!  Poor guy was sick with bacteria that even surprised Dr Reimer. But he healed him enough so he could hibernate!  The staff is great. They all care deeply for pets! Great hospital!!
100 % recommend this place. Dr. Katia Shinkle is a very caring and attentive doctor. Always friendly and professional. Thank you!
Thank you for taking good care 🫶 …

Thank you so much for taking care of my sweet Frankie for the past 7 years. No matter what he was going through, you always welcomed him with open arms and treated him with kindness, compassion, and so much love.

He had a good life  and I know a big part of that was because of the care you gave him. I’ll never forget when the doctor looked at him and said, “Frankie, I think you’re a cat  you must have more than one life!” That moment stayed with me. He truly was a fighter, and your team helped him keep going time after time.

You were there for him through every stage of his life  from routine visits to the most difficult moments. Even until his last day, you cared for him with the same love and dedication as always. That means more to me than words can express.

Frankie wasn’t just a pet he was family, and you treated him like yours. I’m forever thankful for everything you did to help him live those 7 full years with comfort, dignity, and love.

Picking up his ashes was one of the hardest moments of my life, but knowing he was in your care from the beginning to the end brings me comfort. Frankie wasn’t just a dog  he was my best friend.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for everything. 🐾❤️

Giving this vet location a one-star. The communication is horrible. I have called the vet, for a refill for my pup's eye medication. I gave the receptionist all the details, about what I needed. They pathetically gave me a call two weeks after to ask if I still needed it.  I won't be taking any of my pets there, even tho it's five minutes from where I
live.

Have seen Dr.Reimer for yrs with a variety of pets for my family and a pet rescue and adoption ctr from tiny to lg. He is my most loved  vet I  have ever met. Great w/patients and any people. Explains everything in a way anyone can understand. Both vets are wonderful and so are all the staff. So happy he opened his own ofc yrs ago, because I loved him from the beginning, but I didn't  like the ofc. He was at prev, I would always ask for him but it didn't always happen unless it was my personal pet. I've referred  a few people and they referred oth friends, all extremely happy, of course that's yrs ago. If and when you can get on a list it's worth the wait. Sorry Dr. Amata(sp) you are great too, I just met Dr.Reimer 1st so long ago.❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Recently took my 9 month kittens to get spayed and fix a hernia. This location was the one closest to me with the best reviews and they did not disappoint. The staff and there procedures were amazing. They kept me updated on the surgeries and we'll being of my babies. And that helped me so much. Kept me saine while they were gone. Thank you All Pets Medical Centre and also a BIG thank you to Doctor Imada!
They have been caring for my animal companions for almost a decade. Their care and compassion when handling my cats and dogs is really admirable and I can't recommend them any more highly.
Very good place . I have 2 dogs & 1 cat . All goes only here . 👍 …

I had the best first and best experience here at this clinic on the last Saturday of November. I brought my Guinea Pig Panda for a consultation of the quality of life, and the Doctor along with the veterinarian assistant Sophie handled my case so well. They were both very sweet and understand of the situation, and made sure everything would be okay.

Given their protocols to euthanize my pet, I spent my last moments with my fur baby and I was very thankful to be there before they took him away…

I work in this field and I can side with citizens that prices for euthanizing pets could be expensive, but THIS clinic for the services they provide with absolute care and sincerity, I highly recommend this hospital for your dog, cat, bunny, Guinea pig, etc.

Thank you to all that work at this clinic from the bottom of my heart.
Dr Reimer is the best.
Been seeing Dr. Reimer for years. Great with ferrets.
Great Vets! I've followed them through 3 locations. Kind, wonderful over the years they've helped me raise 3 yellow Labs, 1 black lab, 1 Dobie, and nowa new yellow lab puppy! Try them!
